description: Declaration of OS-specific utility functions for process management, file operations, debugging, and system info within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Abstract class representing a system process with methods to control and query process state.

classes.name: ProcessHandle
classes.description: Final class managing a process handle, allowing process control and retrieval.

methods.name: SetLowPriorityProcess
methods.description: Set the current process to low priority.

methods.name: WriteDebugMessage
methods.description: Write a debug message to output or debug window.

methods.name: StabilizeCPUForBenchmarking
methods.description: Set thread affinity and priority for benchmarking.

methods.name: InitCrashHandler
methods.description: Initialize crash handler with a callback to print stack traces.

methods.name: CreateTemporaryFile
methods.description: Create a temporary file and return its path.

methods.name: CreateTemporaryFileInDir
methods.description: Create a temporary file in specified directory.

methods.name: ReadEntireFileToString
methods.description: Read file contents into a string.

methods.name: LaunchProcess
methods.description: Launch a process with command line arguments, optionally capturing stdout and stderr.

methods.name: NumberOfProcessors
methods.description: Get the number of processor cores.
